scope: explicit experiment runs -> comparability gate -> M# evidence -> /chat -> citation validation

design_basis.adopted_boundary: M# is reserved for structured experiment measurements; incompatible comparisons must not compute or expose changes; causes remain candidate or pending until validated.
Keep metrics, parameters, dataset/evaluation references, and artifacts bound to a run before comparing measurements; implementation remains a local lightweight ledger adapter.

implemented: The experiment comparison result is converted into bounded M# evidence only when status=comparable and change_computation=enabled.
M# retains metric, baseline/current values, delta, split, definition, dataset, evaluation script, and baseline/current source locators.
Only an explicitly selected baseline_run_id and current_run_id can enter /chat; /chat never infers a last-month run.
The workflow plan endpoint and /chat both block missing, cross-project, or non-comparable run pairs before model generation.
The answer prompt, retry instruction, citation validator, fallback checks, mindmap extraction, and offline evaluator recognize M# without mixing it into document E# evidence.
The experiment comparison workflow UI loads current-project runs and requires separate baseline/current selections.
The evidence panel renders M# values, delta, split/definition, both source locators, and the non-causal comparability boundary separately from document evidence.

targeted_backend.command: pytest -q tests/test_experiment_ledger.py tests/test_interaction_context.py tests/test_multimodal_workflows.py tests/test_rag_prompting.py tests/test_answer_quality.py tests/test_mcp_server_indexing.py

regressions: A comparable pair produced M1 with the numeric change and row-level source locators.
A blocked comparison produced no M# evidence.
A main chat request with two explicit comparable runs delivered the comparison payload to the RAG interaction context.
An incompatible pair was blocked by the workflow plan before generation.
claims_not_supported: No real-model answer accuracy, retrieval recall, or sealed-test gain is claimed.
No automatic last-month run selection was added; ambiguity still requires explicit user selection.
M# supports measured change and source location, but does not establish causal attribution without a discriminating experiment.
The encrypted production workspace was not rebuilt or modified without its unlock key.
